## GET /admin-api/oidfed

`getOidfed`

**This realm as an OpenID Federation entity: its role, Entity Configuration, keys, subordinates, Trust Anchors and Trust Marks**

Everything /admin/oidfed draws, out of the same view function: the realm's Entity Identifier and role (trust anchor, intermediate or leaf), its authority hints and federation endpoints, its Federation Entity Keys (public halves, states and history — never a private key), the subordinates it vouches for, the Trust Anchors it trusts, the Trust Mark types it issues, the marks it has issued and carries, the mark policies it publishes as a Trust Anchor, the resolutions it holds, and the claims of its current Entity Configuration — and, for each subordinate, whether it is suspended and its event history, the subordinates it has revoked with theirs (#137), and the Entity Collection crawl it keeps (#136). The keys, subordinates, revoked subordinates, Trust Anchors, issued and carried marks and mark policies are each one page, moved by a parameter of its own with `per` shared; `counts` holds each list's whole length and `paging` where each page is. A subordinate's `events` are its latest 25, with `eventsTotal`; the whole history is at /oidfed/subordinate-events. The oidfed.* settings are written through POST /admin-api/config/set-many.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/oidfed` on the admin console.

The reply also carries `protocolEndpoints`: every endpoint of this family in the realm the call arrived in, as `{ name, methods, url }` (plus `route` for an HTTP endpoint, `transport` for a socket, and `registered: false` for a route the router no longer has).

Scope: `admin:read`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `keysPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of the Federation Entity Keys. Clamped, like every page parameter here. |
| `subordinatesPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of the subordinates. Clamped, like every page parameter here. |
| `formerPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of the revoked subordinates. Clamped, like every page parameter here. |
| `anchorsPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of the Trust Anchors. Clamped, like every page parameter here. |
| `issuedPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of the Trust Marks this realm issued. Clamped, like every page parameter here. |
| `heldPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of the Trust Marks this realm carries. Clamped, like every page parameter here. |
| `policiesPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of the Trust Mark policies. Clamped, like every page parameter here. |
| `per` | query | integer |  | Rows per page, shared by the seven lists. |

## POST /admin-api/oidfed/add-held-mark

`addOidfedHeldMark`

**Carry a Trust Mark issued to this realm**

The Entity Configuration carries it in trust_marks (3.1.2).

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/oidfed` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trustMark` | string | yes | A trust-mark+jwt whose sub is this realm. |

| `errors` | list |  |  |

| `message` | string |  |  |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |

## POST /admin-api/oidfed/add-mark-type

`addOidfedMarkType`

**Issue Trust Marks of a type**

Registers a type this realm issues, with its lifetime and, where another entity owns the type, the delegation it issues under (7.2).

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/oidfed` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delegation` | string |  | A trust-mark-delegation+jwt. |

| `logoUri` | string |  |  |

## POST /admin-api/oidfed/add-subordinate

`addOidfedSubordinate`

**Register an entity this realm vouches for**

The entity becomes a subordinate: the fetch endpoint issues a Subordinate Statement about it carrying its keys and whatever metadata, metadata policy and constraints are given here. Its keys are given (`jwks`) or read from its own Entity Configuration (`fetchJwks`, through the outbound policy).

## POST /admin-api/oidfed/suspend-subordinate

`suspendOidfedSubordinate`

**Suspend a subordinate**

The realm issues no Subordinate Statement about it and lists it nowhere until it is reinstated, so no Trust Chain passes through it; its history records the suspension (#137). A realm of this service beneath the default realm may be suspended too.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/oidfed` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entityId` | string | yes | An Entity Identifier: an https URL with no query or fragment. |
| `informationUri` | string |  | An http or https URL of a page about the event, recorded as its information_uri. |
| `reason` | string |  | Recorded as the event_description of the event this act adds to the subordinate's history. |

**200**: What was done, with the record where there is one.
